claims.text: Question, diagram and explanation: Among neutral, isolated gas-phase atoms of Na and Mg, which has the higher first ionization energy? Mg has the higher first ionization energy. Across these two elements, magnesium has a higher first ionization energy than sodium. First ionization energy is the energy required to remove the first electron from an isolated gaseous atom.
